A secret worth keeping.

No tapping your card. No telling us its name. Just a little imagination.

  1. Choose any of the 21 cards and remember it. Press “I’ve got my card” when you’re ready.
  2. Find your card and choose its row. The cards will move, so look carefully each time.
  3. Choose its row three times in total. Then let us reveal your card!
